e1m1.name: Boot Sector
e1m1.title: E1M1   BOOT SECTOR
intro: Episode 1: Roasted in the Shell.
Find the x key. Beyond the x door, something keeps time.

events.keyroom: The key room's walls grind open. They were waiting for you to touch it.
events.arena: The x door slams shut and locks behind you.
events.boss_escaped: Far away, the sealed door unlocks.
events.goggles: Clunk. Somewhere near, a door slides open while the plate stays down.

e1m1.boss_escaped_line: Cron escaped. He will be waiting at the end of time.

e1m9.name: Swap Partition
e1m9.title: E1M9   SWAP PARTITION
intro: Where the facility sends what it cannot keep in mind.
Belts carry the pages out. Somebody spilled the coolant. Do not smoke.

events.coolant: Clunk. The plate stays down, and a closet in the north wall slides open.

e1m2.name: Dynamic Loader
e1m2.title: E1M2   DYNAMIC LOADER
intro: The cargo dock, where everything the facility runs is loaded first.
A loader stands in its bay. The w key is across the acid; the control room is behind the w door.

e1m3.name: Drone Refit Assembly
e1m3.title: E1M3: Drone Refit Assembly
intro: Where the facility's drones are built again from what is left of them.
The press is still running. Somewhere past the launch gate, a hopper waits for fuel.

events.chute: A hatch grinds open at the top of the chute. Something heavy rolls out of it. RUN.
events.launch_gate: Far off, sirens. The launch gate's locks let go and it rolls open on the swamp.

e1m4.name: Xantrium Fens
e1m4.title: E1M4: Xantrium Fens
intro: Open country: the fens past the refit plant, as far as the sim can draw them.
The relay mast blinks red to the north-east. Its switch ends the simulatron.

sim1.name: Long Fens
sim1.title: SIM-1: Long Fens
intro: A free program of the simulatron: the fens with no edge to them, made new each time it runs.
Somewhere 230 cells to the north-east a relay mast blinks red. Walk, or find a hopper with fuel in it.

sim2.name: Deep Swap
sim2.title: SIM-2: Deep Swap
intro: A free program of the simulatron: swap space, a new floor every time, each one deeper and worse.
The w key opens the way to the exit. How deep can you go?

sim3.name: Swap Sprawl
sim3.title: SIM-3: Swap Sprawl
intro: A free program of the simulatron: swap space with no walls round it, a room for every turn.
The exit is a few rooms off, in some direction. The further you go, the worse it gets.

sim4.name: Kill House
sim4.title: SIM-4: Kill House
intro: A training program of the simulatron: combat tactics against squads.
A pack that circles before it bites, a sweep squad that bounds and marks its doorways,
an ambush that waits for you to walk in, and an assault on a bunker. Use the cover.

sim10.name: Root Shell
sim10.title: SIM-10: Root Shell
intro: A training program of the simulatron: the shell beneath the mainframe.
Jack into the terminal (face it, Enter) to open the door: a card duel against its ICE.
A sentinel guards the way out. It deals too.

t.label: TERMINAL
t.duel_won: The ICE melts. A door unlocks somewhere.

sim11.name: Deep Works
sim11.title: SIM-11: Deep Works
intro: A training program of the simulatron: the pumping station under the facility.
Magboots for the coolant deck, stairs and a magnetic shaft, a jetpack for the drop,
and the flooded vault - swim it, dive under its bulkhead, and take the bathyscaphe.

e1m5.name: User Space
e1m5.title: E1M5   USER SPACE
intro: Uplink complete. User space: where the processes live - the recruits' quarters, the
quartermaster's heap, and the syscall gate down to the kernel. Your pod is six. So is your locker.

events.own_locker: Locker six: your name on the door, your jacket, your own chaingun, and a photo of a man you do not know. On the back, in your hand: "Not yet."
events.barracks_alarm: The locker's alarm whoops. In the bunks, something sits up.
events.mmu_west: The west half of the field flickers out.
events.mmu_east: The east half of the field flickers out.
events.time_slice: SCHEDULER: one time slice granted. The door to the kernel lift opens.

e1m6.name: Kernel Space
e1m6.title: E1M6   KERNEL SPACE
intro: Ring 0. The hall hums like a held breath; the floor is not one floor here but many - a gallery
a storey up, the scheduler's dais in tiers, the interrupt well sunk under it all. On the dais
a crontab ticks. Every line of it has your name.

events.crontab: crontab -e. You put a # in front of every line with your name on it. Up in the gallery a door unlocks.

e1m7.name: The Stack
e1m7.title: E1M7   THE STACK
intro: Under kernel space the stack grows downward, frame under frame - and something has filled it.
Overflow: the floors are awash with it. The ceilings are plated for the maintenance drones.
You have boots for plating. Somewhere above the last frame is the return address.

events.frame: RET: the return address pops. Down by the floor, the frame's door slides open.
events.unwind: The stack unwinds: behind you the plating dies, frame by frame. Keep moving.

e1m8.name: Aspiration Central
e1m8.title: E1M8   ASPIRATION CENTRAL
intro: Out of the stack, into a city under rain. Over it all stands the Metacron - the spire of collective
control, the scheduler of schedulers - and its doors are sealed. Its face is glass and steel, a
storey a breath, all the way up. Your boots hold to steel.

events.core: The core hall. Under the broken dome something vast turns to face you.
events.metacron_down: The Metacron's light goes out of it. Through the dome you see the city's go out too, street by street. Somewhere a door unlocks.

sim12.name: Stairwell
sim12.title: SIM-12: Stairwell
intro: A training program of the simulatron: the station's stairwell, drawn as it stands.
Real stairs up to the mezzanine, a pump pit sunk in the floor, a low passage and a ramp
down to the way out. A step higher than your knee is a wall to you - and to them.

sim13.name: Proving Ground
sim13.title: SIM-13: Proving Ground
intro: A training program of the simulatron: ground that is not flat. A ramp, a sewer tube, a yard in the rain -
wet slopes do not hold you; jump the pits (F7), and jump again in the air for the far one (F8). Then a
pressure suit for the vacuum deck, and the mechwalker in its bay. Watch how each of them walks.
